narrationScript: Welcome to Module 6.3: Server-Side Development with Flask in Python! Up until now, we've mostly focused on what happens directly in your browser – the client-side. But to build truly dynamic and data-driven web applications, we need to understand the server. In this module, we'll dive into how web servers work, specifically using Flask, a powerful yet lightweight Python framework. Our journey will cover several key areas: first, we'll distinguish between client-side and server-side development, understanding where each piece of code runs. Then, we'll explore the fundamental communication protocol of the web, HTTP, and its crucial methods like GET and POST. You'll learn how to set up your very first Flask application, define routes to handle different web addresses, and generate dynamic HTML content using Flask's templating engine, Jinja2. Finally, we'll tackle how to process form data submitted by users, making your applications interactive and responsive. By the end of this module, you'll have a solid foundation for building your own server-side web applications with Python and Flask.
